about: What the site ships (plan/pipelines.md §15, section A; rulings 6, R22), kept by hand: per component its package and version (checked against package-lock.json), its license id, its copyright lines as its own notice states them, the license file in node_modules and the files of the built site that are its (patterns relative to dist/). copyrightFrom names where the lines stand when that is not the license file: a file under node_modules, which the check reads, or a sentence. omit lists lines of the license file that the notice leaves out; licenseUntil ends the part of the file that applies. Whoever changes package-lock.json updates this file in the same commit (plan/pipelines.md, the table of generated and hand-kept files).
